title: Drift retrain cadence: every 3 h on the trainer, or off-VM -- Tier-3 proposal, decided after KAGGLE-TRAIN-RUNNER-FIRST
note: [2026-10-14 weekly planning] Operator direction 2026-10-14: PROPOSAL ONLY. The drift-retrain cadence for advisory heads is a Tier-3 question (model lifecycle feeding live sizing); the two candidate shapes are (a) a 3-hourly drift retrain on the trainer VM inside its windows, (b) drift retrain off-VM once KAGGLE-TRAIN-RUNNER-FIRST's parity gate exists. Do not decide before KAGGLE-TRAIN-RUNNER-FIRST reports; then write the exact proposal (manifests, cadence, cost in trainer-minutes, revert) for an operator yes/no. No config edit under this row. [2026-10-15 lane session_01YH1am2LXDBtyPPp3PFA1gk] NOT STARTED, by design: the dispatch says write the proposal only after the runner parity result. PR #18199 (hold) carries the parity units RQ-20261015-8b93-01/-02; the proposal follows a landed 8b93-02 verdict. [2026-10-16 lane session_01YH1am2LXDBtyPPp3PFA1gk] PROPOSAL for operator yes/no (no config edit made). MEASURED on the trainer (trainer-vm-diag #18485, journal 2026-10-15T20:12Z..2026-10-16T02:15Z): ict-drift-retrain.timer is ENABLED, hourly; the service runs with RETRAIN_PLAN_ONLY=1, so it has NEVER retrained anything. Each plan-only scan costs 12.0-12.7 CPU-min (5 runs: 11.98/12.70/12.12/12.00/12.14) and holds the trainer heavy-job lock about 12 min of every hour; the 01:03Z run waited 60 min for the lock and skipped. That is about 24 x 12.2 = 293 trainer-CPU-min/day, consistent with the 30.45 CPU-h/week (63.7% of trainer service CPU) in trainer-workload-2026-10-13. Every scan flags the SAME 9 manifests (dispatch_count=9 each run; 400-row tail, 16-17 rows per manifest): eth-regime-5m-lgbm-v1, mes-regime-5m-baseline-v1, setup-quality-baseline-v0, sol-regime-15m-lgbm-fc-pcv-v1, sol-regime-15m-lgbm-fc-pcv-v2 (stage ADVISORY), sol-regime-5m-lgbm-v1, btc-regime-15m-lgbm-yz-v1, btc-regime-1h-lgbm-v2, btc-regime-1h-lgbm-yz-v1. Q1 (Tier-2, timer only): OnCalendar=hourly -> '*-*-* 00/3:05:00' (every 3 h), plan-only unchanged. Cost 8 x 12.2 = ~98 trainer-CPU-min/day, saving ~195/day (~23 CPU-h/week) with no model change. Revert: OnCalendar=hourly + daemon-reload. RECOMMEND YES. Q2 (Tier-3, feeds live sizing via the advisory head): arm retrains. (a) on the trainer, RETRAIN_PLAN_ONLY=0 at the 3-h cadence: 9 manifests x ~0.4-0.9 min (nightly per-manifest 25-55 s, design doc section 3; the 5m ones are heavier and NOT measured) = up to ~8 trainer-min per round, ~64/day on top of Q1. (b) off-VM: only 3 of the 9 are on published shards today (btc-regime-1h-lgbm-v2, btc-regime-1h-lgbm-yz-v1, btc-regime-15m-lgbm-yz-v1, all LightGBM multiclass, the class the parity gate passed), plus sol-regime-15m-lgbm-fc-pcv-v2 once the SOL 15m shard stops being withheld (ML-SHARD-TRUNCATED). The other 5 cannot leave the VM (3 on unexported 5m/v530 shards, 1 MES RegimeClassifier, 1 OURS setup_labels). The export is daily (06:40Z), so (b) is at best a daily-fresh retrain, not 3-hourly. Revert for either: RETRAIN_PLAN_ONLY=1; retrained versions register as new runs and promotion-readiness still gates them. RECOMMEND HOLD on Q2: the same 9 flagged across 17 consecutive scans is persistent drift, which the drift-remediation skill treats as a capability question, not a cadence one. INFERRED, not verified: the flag persists because the scan reads shadow scores across model versions. Needs a drift-remediation pass on the 9, starting with the advisory sol-regime-15m-lgbm-fc-pcv-v2, before any auto-retrain is armed.
